title: Splitting Rules from Kinematic Flow: Local Evolution and Emergent Time
summary: The differential equations satisfied by the wavefunction coefficients of conformally coupled scalars in a power-law cosmology can be recast as an iterative differential system of basis functions. These functions can be encoded within graph tubings and are governed by a set of rules describing how they flow in kinematic space. In this paper, we formulate a set of splitting rules equivalent to the kinematic flow at tree level by reversing the flow direction of graph tubings.
